about.text: Full-Stack Developer with almost 3 years of experience specializing in Java (Spring Boot / Microservices) and Angular/React. I have experience developing robust RESTful APIs, modernizing legacy systems, and implementing secure authentication using Keycloak. My unique background in healthcare further enhances my technical profile with advanced soft skills in high-pressure decision-making, precision, and adaptability.🌍 EU Citizen (French Passport) with full availability for relocation and international travel.
